big-news.text: A person was found dead in a home in Ringerike just after midnight. Police are treating it as a murder, and one person has been arrested and charged.
There's an update on the Borr Drilling rig that sank off Gabon. Of the 115 people on board, 110 are accounted for, and Reuters reports one dead and four still missing.
34 mayors are pushing back on the cost of cleaning up the Oslofjord, and the climate minister disagrees with their criticism.

oslo.text: A train's brakes caught fire at Lillestrøm station on Sunday evening. Everyone got off safely, but the station was closed and trains stopped, so check Vy before you head east.
Police have put out an international wanted notice for a man in his 30s, charged over Saturday's stabbing of a woman in a Bjørvika parking garage. She is seriously hurt but not in critical condition.

be-aware.text: The orange flood warning after Storm Boelo starts easing from 07:00 today, but streams and rivers may still be high.

Preparedness week starts today. A survey by DSB, Norway's civil protection agency, found that over 60% of people aren't ready for a long internet and mobile outage. DSB suggests a battery-powered DAB radio, a charged power bank and a friend you agree to check on.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Extra Delicious throws a Halloween dance night at Vulkan 5 on Friday, Oct 30, and it's free before 22:00.
Artist Isabelle Andriessen gives a free talk at the Oslo National Academy of the Arts (KHiO) today, and on Wednesday its opera students give a free lunchtime concert.
There's a free All Saints' concert with violin and organ at the church at Ullernveien 28 on Saturday, Oct 31 at 12:00.
